# brig service detach

Take a sandbox's token for a service away

## Synopsis

```text
brig service detach SERVICE [VM] SANDBOX
```

## Description

Revoke a sandbox's token for a service, so that the service refuses it, and
delete its provider from the gateway. If the VM does not run, its gateway
keeps the provider until the VM's next start; the service refuses the token
at once.

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-w, --workspace string` | the workspace of the gateway to work in (default: $BRIG\_WORKSPACE, else default) |

The [global options](brig.md#options) of brig apply too.
